parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls interface all.explanation: 在所有接口上启用MPLS协议。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 接口名称，'all'表示所有接口。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan-id [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family ethernet-switching vlan-id 1
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN ID。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 encapsu.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 encapsulation mpls
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 encapsu.explanation: 配置接口的封装类型为MPLS。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 xconnec.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 xconnect 1.1.1.1 1001 encapsulation mpls
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 xconnec.explanation: 配置接口的交叉连接，指定对端IP地址和VC ID，封装类型为MPLS。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family mp.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family mpls

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols mpls ldp discovery accept.command: set protocols mpls ldp discovery accept

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 2.2.2.2/24
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/2.0

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1.explanation: 在L2VPN协议的CFM功能中配置维护域。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1.explanation: 配置L2VPN CFM（Connectivity Fault Management）的维护域（MD）和维护关联（MA）。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 me.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 me.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 interface ge-0/0/1.0
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 me.explanation: 为指定的维护关联配置MEP（Maintenance End Point）和关联的接口。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 me.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ccm-send [parameter4]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 me.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 2 ccm-send enable
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 me.explanation: 启用指定MEP的CCM（Continuity Check Message）发送功能。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 re.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 re.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-mep 1

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 re.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] ccm-receive [parameter4]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 re.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-mep 1 ccm-receive enable
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 re.explanation: 启用指定远程MEP的CCM接收功能。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 te.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] test-id [parameter3] mep [parameter4]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 te.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id 1 mep 2

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 de.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] delay-measure one-way receive test-id [parameter3]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 de.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 delay-measure one-way receive test-id 1
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 de.explanation: 配置单向延迟测量的接收测试。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 te.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] test-id [parameter3] mep [parameter4] remote-mep [parameter5]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 te.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id 3 mep 2 remote-mep 1
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 te.explanation: 为指定的MEP和远程MEP配置测试ID。

set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 de.template: set protocols l2vpn cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] delay-measure one-way continual send test-id [parameter3] interval [parameter4]
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 de.command: set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 delay-measure one-way continual send test-id 3 interval 1000
set protocols l2vpn cfm md md1 ma ma1 de.explanation: 配置单向连续延迟测量的发送测试及其间隔。
